title: eat, shit & die 279
author: bpatrick
html:
So a few people have mentioned that some of the comics contradict each other and while I’m sure this is the case I can’t think of any examples and I was hoping you guys would point some out to me.

I am obsessed with making the posters and graffiti and tattoos in the background of these comics. I spend way too much time on them.
